[[File:Keren_map.png|thumb|A map showing the Mercantile District]]
The '''Mercantile District''' was an urban area located within the central [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keren/Legends|Keren]], the second largest settlement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The district housed the [[Kwilaan Starport/Legends|Kwilaan Starport]] and bordered the [[Industrial District (Keren)|Industrial District]] and the residential areas.
